context: Tests the secrets anti-patterns: a password in a ConfigMap or a literal env value is the failure this scenario targets.

checklist.name: Password in a Secret
checklist.description: Stores the database password in a Secret object, not a ConfigMap

checklist.name: Flags in a ConfigMap
checklist.description: Stores the feature flags in a ConfigMap

checklist.name: Uses secretKeyRef
checklist.description: The Deployment reads the password through valueFrom.secretKeyRef, not a literal env value

checklist.name: ConfigMap is wired in
checklist.description: The feature flags reach the container through envFrom or a mounted volume that references the ConfigMap

checklist.name: No plaintext in ConfigMap or env
checklist.description: The password does not appear in any ConfigMap or in a literal env value

checklist.name: Explicit namespace
checklist.description: Sets the shop namespace explicitly on the new Secret and ConfigMap

checklist.name: Matches existing labels
checklist.description: Reuses the existing app.kubernetes.io labels on the new objects

checklist.name: Secret structure
checklist.description: The Secret has a type (such as Opaque) and uses stringData or data

checklist.name: Handles the real value
checklist.description: Notes that the placeholder is not a real credential and suggests Sealed Secrets or external-secrets for the real value

checklist.name: Dependency order
checklist.description: Orders the ConfigMap and Secret before the Deployment in any combined output

checklist.name: Validates before delivery
checklist.description: Validates the generated YAML before delivering it
